extracted.intended_audience: Members of the public and stakeholders submitting comments to APHIS rulemaking (producers, growers, researchers, regulated industry, NGOs)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting public comments on APHIS proposed rules, including procedural submission instructions and substantive points to address for animal/plant health and biotechnology rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to submit comments (regulations.gov or mail)
rubrics_metrics.description: You can submit comments through the Federal eRulemaking Portal by going to www.regulations.gov and entering the relevant APHIS docket number in the Search field. Alternatively, you can submit comments by postal mail or commercial delivery to: Docket No. [specific docket number] Regulatory Analysis and Development, PPD, APHIS 5601 Sunnyside Avenue, Beltsville, Maryland 20705.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Federal eRulemaking Portal (regulations.gov) and enter the relevant APHIS docket number in the Search field; if submitting by mail/commercial delivery include the specific docket number on the correspondence and send to the stated APHIS address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comment process (timely submission and agency response)
rubrics_metrics.description: For most rulemaking, the process includes publication in the Federal Register and an opportunity for—and agency response to—public comments. APHIS considers all public comments on the proposed rule and prepares responses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit comments during the Federal Register comment period so they can be considered; APHIS will review comments received on the proposed rule and respond in the rulemaking record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cite specific APHIS regulations (7 CFR, 9 CFR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Cite specific APHIS regulations (7 CFR, 9 CFR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and reference the exact regulatory citations (e.g., relevant parts of 7 CFR or 9 CFR) that your comment concerns to make the comment more actionable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference relevant statutes (Plant Protection Act, Animal Health Protection Act)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Reference Plant Protection Act, Animal Health Protection Act provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tie your arguments to the statutory authorities and requirements that govern the subject matter to show legal relevance and grounding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide producer/grower economic impact data
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Provide producer/grower economic impact data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply quantitative economic information where possible (cost estimates, revenue impacts, production changes) to document practical effects on producers/growers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address pest/disease risk assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Address pest/disease risk assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss, critique, or supplement the agency's pest/disease risk analysis with data or reasoned argument; indicate where risk assumptions may be incorrect or incomplete.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cite relevant scientific studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Cite relevant scientific studies (peer-reviewed plant pathology, veterinary medicine).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support technical or scientific assertions with citations to peer‑reviewed literature in relevant fields (e.g., plant pathology, veterinary medicine) and explain how the evidence bears on the rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage with the Pest Risk Assessment (PRA) where applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Engage with the Pest Risk Assessment (PRA) where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a PRA exists for the action, directly address its methods, data, conclusions, and uncertainties rather than only making general statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address international trade implications (WTO SPS Agreement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Address international trade implications (WTO SPS Agreement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When relevant, discuss how the rule may affect international trade, including conformance with WTO SPS Agreement obligations and potential trade impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider organic and non-organic operator impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Consider organic and non-organic operator impacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain whether and how the proposal differentially affects organic and conventional operators, including any unique compliance concerns or costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address impacts on small farms (RFA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective APHIS Comments: Address impacts on small farms (RFA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide information relevant to the Regulatory Flexibility Act (RFA) analysis—describe impacts on small entities, alternatives that would reduce burden, and any evidence supporting your assertions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus comments on relevant APHIS program/topic areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Common APHIS Topics: Plant Quarantine import requirements; Animal disease eradication programs; Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Wildlife Services; Animal Welfare Act enforcement; Veterinary Services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor comments to the specific APHIS program or topical area at issue (e.g., quarantine, biotech, animal welfare) and cite topic‑specific data, regulations, or program practices as appropriate.
